regulatoryLine: Mapped to the ESPR passport requirements (Reg. (EU) 2024/1781 Art. 9 and Annex III) and binding EU textile labelling law (Reg. (EU) 1007/2011), ready to absorb the textile delegated act when adopted.
note: No delegated act exists for textiles, so no field here is presented as settled by one. Every field names the instrument it comes from in legalRef, and any field whose permitted form waits on the act carries awaitingAct instead of an invented list. Posture: aligned with, never compliant.
sources: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 (ESPR): Art. 4 and Annex I for the product parameters, Art. 9 and Annex III for passport contents, Art. 7(5) for substances of concern
Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 on textile fibre names and labelling: binding today, and the source of the fibre composition and animal-origin declarations
Directive (EU) 2024/825 on empowering consumers: durability and reparability claims
Directive 2008/98/EC as amended: textile extended producer responsibility and separate collection
ISO 3758, ISO 5077, ISO 6330, ISO 12945 and the ISO 105 series, for the test methods the performance values are measured by

registers.name: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
registers.use: Every value typed country. Officially assigned codes only; user-assigned and exceptionally-reserved codes are excluded so a passport cannot name a place no register resolves.

conventions.resolved: Constraints are resolved, not implied: a percent field carries minimum 0 and maximum 100 explicitly, and a country field carries its pattern. No type-specific defaults need reapplying.
conventions.closed: closed:true means options are exhaustive and a value outside them is invalid. closed:false means the list is what is known in practice and a value outside it is valid, because the source names no exhaustive vocabulary. A field with options and no closed key is closed.
conventions.awaitingAct: awaitingAct names a delegated or implementing act that will fix this value's permitted form. Until it is adopted no list or pattern is stated, because stating one would publish a guess as a standard. Do not reject values on this field.
conventions.prose: prose:true marks a value that is meant to be written for a person to read. It is a deliberate per-field decision, not an absent constraint.
conventions.record: type:record carries fields describing its parts. With repeat:true the value is an array of such records; without, a single one.

fields.label: Product name
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(a); the passport has to say what the product is
fields.note: The name the brand sells it under, written by a person for a person.

fields.label: Kind of product
fields.legalRef: ESPR Art. 4; the parameters that apply depend on what the product is
fields.note: Open: ESPR scope for textiles is set by the delegated act, so a closed list would be our guess wearing the regulation’s clothes.

fields.label: Model or style reference
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(b): the unique product identifier is model-level

fields.label: Batch
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(b); Reg. 1007/2011 traceability of a labelled lot

fields.label: Article number (GTIN)
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(c): commodity and trade item codes where they exist

fields.label: Brand name
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(e); Reg. 1007/2011 Art. 15 identifies the responsible operator
fields.note: A company name; nothing to constrain it to but itself.

fields.label: Brand contact
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(e): the operator has to be reachable, not merely named
fields.note: An email, a postal address or a page. Constraining it to one shape would exclude the others.

fields.label: EU operator identifier
fields.awaitingAct: the ESPR implementing act on unique operator identifiers
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(e)
fields.note: Declared and not captured: the identifier scheme does not exist yet, so an empty box would invite a made-up value.

fields.label: Where it was made
fields.legalRef: Reg. 1007/2011 Art. 16 read with the Union Customs Code origin rules

fields.label: Made
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(a): a durability claim is meaningless without a start date

fields.label: Colour
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. It identifies the item to the person holding it.
fields.note: Brands name colours, and the name is part of the product.

fields.label: Size
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. It is what makes a passport match the garment in hand.
fields.note: Size systems differ by market and by brand; a closed list would be wrong somewhere.

fields.label: Weight
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(l): resource use, and the basis of every per-mass figure below

fields.label: Fibre composition
fields.legalRef: Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Art. 5, 9 and 14: binding today, by weight, in descending order

fields.label: Non-textile parts of animal origin
fields.conditional: the product contains non-textile parts of animal origin
fields.legalRef: Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Art. 12: mandatory where such parts are present
fields.note: The regulation asks for a phrase, not a code: "contains non-textile parts of animal origin".

fields.label: Recycled content
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(g): recycled content is a named parameter; the threshold waits on the act

fields.label: Bio-based content
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. Declared where a brand can substantiate it.

fields.label: Trims and hardware
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(d) and (n): what separates for repair, and what separates for recycling

fields.label: Substances of concern
fields.conditional: a substance of concern is present above the threshold the act will set
fields.legalRef: ESPR Art. 7(5): substances of concern must be traceable through the passport

fields.label: What that means for you
fields.legalRef: ESPR Art. 9(2)(b): passport information shall be complete and comprehensible
fields.note: A list of CAS numbers tells a consumer nothing. This is the sentence that does.

fields.label: Chemical compliance evidence
fields.legalRef: REACH Art. 33 read with ESPR Annex III(d): compliance documentation

fields.label: Microplastic release
fields.awaitingAct: the harmonised test method for microfibre release
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(k); the method is not yet fixed
fields.note: No measurement method is harmonised, so a number here would be incomparable with anyone else’s.

fields.label: Care
fields.legalRef: ISO 3758 care symbols; Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2 on durability information

fields.label: How to make it last
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(a): extending lifetime is the parameter; this is how
fields.note: The advice a maker would give in person, which no symbol carries.

fields.label: Expected lifetime
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(a) and Dir. (EU) 2024/825: a durability claim must be substantiated

fields.label: Tested to
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(b) reliability, tested per ISO 6330 domestic washing procedures

fields.label: Colour fastness
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(b), graded 1-5 per the ISO 105 series

fields.label: Dimensional change after washing
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(b), measured per ISO 5077

fields.label: Pilling resistance
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(b), graded 1-5 per ISO 12945

fields.label: Guarantee
fields.legalRef: Dir. (EU) 2024/825: a commercial guarantee of durability must state its term

fields.label: Repairability
fields.awaitingAct: the ESPR delegated act on repairability scoring for textiles
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(c) and Art. 7(2)(b)(iii)
fields.note: The scoring class is not fixed, so a letter or a number here would be invented.

fields.label: Spare parts
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(d): availability of spare parts is a named parameter
fields.note: Which parts, and for how long. A yes/no would hide the part that matters.

fields.label: Repair instructions
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(e): access to repair information

fields.label: Where to get it repaired
fields.legalRef: Dir. (EU) 2024/825 recital 22: repair should be the visible option

fields.label: Carbon footprint
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(m), computed per the Apparel and Footwear PEFCR

fields.label: The study behind the figure
fields.legalRef: ESPR Art. 9(2)(b): a figure a reader cannot check is not information

fields.label: Environmental footprint class
fields.awaitingAct: the ESPR delegated act setting performance classes for textiles
fields.legalRef: ESPR Art. 7(4)
fields.note: The class format is not set. Naming one would publish our guess as a grade.

fields.label: Water use
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(l): resource use. Declared where a brand has measured it.

fields.label: Where to return it
fields.legalRef: Waste Framework Directive: separate collection of textiles since 1 January 2025
fields.note: A place and a method, in the words the person returning it will use.

fields.label: How it can be recycled
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(n): expected generation of waste materials
fields.note: What a recycler can actually do with it, which no percentage conveys.

fields.label: What comes apart
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex I(h) and (i): ease of disassembly, for reuse and recycling
fields.note: Which components separate, and how. The sentence a dismantler needs.

fields.label: Producer responsibility registration
fields.legalRef: Waste Framework Directive textile EPR: the producer register number

fields.label: Supply chain
fields.legalRef: ESPR Annex III(f): unique facility identifiers, at the stages that have them

fields.label: Independent certification
fields.legalRef: Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2: a sustainability label needs a certification behind it
fields.note: Open: a closed list of schemes would read as an endorsement of exactly those.

fields.label: Due diligence report
fields.legalRef: Dir. (EU) 2024/1760 corporate sustainability due diligence, where in scope

fields.label: Provenance
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. It is the owner tier the selective-disclosure demo turns on.
fields.note: The story of this particular item, which is prose by definition.

fields.label: Purchased
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. It is what makes the record theirs.
fields.note: Where and when, as the owner would write it.

fields.label: Alterations and fit
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. An altered garment is a different garment to its owner.
fields.note: Sleeve lengths and hems, in the tailor’s words.

fields.label: Guarantee registration
fields.legalRef: Nothing requires this. It saves the owner keeping a receipt.
